if x > 5 is code. if customer_is_angry needs a model. A semantic condition is a classifier.
Classic classifiers bake labels into the head. Decision models take the question as input: new question, no retraining.
Same mechanism as Jev, not the same guarantees: calibration, many questions per state, API logprob caps.
Live: drag the temperature. Raw post-RLHF logprobs are overconfident; one temperature fitted on ~100 gold labels fixes most of it (Guo et al. 2017).
